---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::memote=0.17.0

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process MEMOTE_REPORT {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/memote:0.17.0--pyhdfd78af_0' :
        'quay.io/biocontainers/memote:0.17.0--pyhdfd78af_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(model)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.html"), emit: report , topic: report
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('memote'), eval("memote --version | sed 's/memote, version //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_memote

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    export HOME=\${PWD}
    export COBRA_SOLVER=glpk_exact

    memote report snapshot \\
        --filename ${prefix}.html \\
        ${args} \\
        ${model}
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    export HOME=\${PWD}
    export COBRA_SOLVER=glpk_exact

    touch ${prefix}.html
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/memote/report"
description: "Generate HTML quality report snapshot for genome-scale metabolic models"
keywords:
- "metabolic model"
- "sbml"
- "quality control"
tools:
- memote:
    description: "Benchmark and compare genome-scale metabolic models and generate\
      \ HTML reports."
    homepage: "https://github.com/opencobra/memote"
    documentation: "https://memote.readthedocs.io/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/opencobra/memote"
    licence:
    - "Apache-2.0"
    identifier: "biotools:memote"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test', single_end:false\
        \ ]\n"
  - model:
      type: "file"
      description: "SBML model file."
      pattern: "*.{xml,sbml}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2332"
output:
  report:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test',\
          \ single_end:false ]\n"
    - '*.html':
        type: "file"
        description: "Memote HTML report for the provided model."
        pattern: "*.html"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2331"
  versions_memote:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - memote:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - memote --version | sed 's/memote, version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  report:
  - - meta:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - '*.html':
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The process the versions were collected from"
    - memote:
        type: "string"
        description: "The tool name"
    - memote --version | sed 's/memote, version //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@brovolia"
maintainers:
- "@brovolia"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
